UNHAPPY VERY BAD CARE at this practice who looked over the care home my mother resided at until she passed away 6 months ago. The two people who are doctors assistants but think they are doctors, spent two months telling me my mother was dying due to heart failure and did not listen to me when i told them there was nothing wrong with her heart. I pleaded and pleaded with them that it was something else and asked why they wouldn't listen to me as Id known my Mum for decades and knew all her medical history and that she did not have a heart problem, i even cared for her at home 5 years prior to her going into the care home. They just kept pushing back at us trying to make us accept their verdict rather than supporting us or using any form of initiative whatsoever. When my dear mother finally was seen by the hospital 2 months later (long waiting time) to check her heart they confirmed there was absolutely nothing wrong with my Mums heart.

During this two month time frame my Mums health continued deteriorating. Assistants no where to be seen offcourse, as they would only come in when we chased them down and even then reluctantly and in a rush. I spent every day at the care home checking on her. Two weeks later Mum became so unwell i asked the carehome to call the ambulance. My mother passed away two weeks later from pneumonia which was the reason she had been unwell all this time, it had nothing to do with heart failure :( Instead of arguing with me, trying to convince me my mothers heart was failing, they should have sent Mum to the hospital for a tests weeks earlier 😢

Although we specifically asked to see the doctor these assistants would show up. In our humble opinion, in such serious circumstances, they should not be allowed to practice as, or act like doctors when they are not qualified. This was an miss use of power it was obvious they had god syndrome, the way they talked and treated us was strong handed and considering the dire circumstances somewhat rude.

We know this can't bring our beautiful mother back but we wanted to provide them feedback for the poor care they provided Mum and our family, to fully understand how their poor care and support effected us so devastatingly rather then letting them look the otherway, so that hopefully they wake up to the humanity required in their role of service to the community and don't effect to many other families lives so tragically and unnecessarily.

To be fair there were many medical "so called" professionals, who were involved during this two months of my mum's life who really let her down. Being there and observing, i can only put this down due to the toxicity of the NHS service and their staff, and the lack of care they show to us all, but these guys were the primary carers for my mum who we relied on and they really let her, and us, down when she needed them
